newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Textile to make 2-for-10 issue.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Textile to make 2-for-10 issue.

text.p: China's Shenzhen Textile (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Monday it would make a two-for-10 bonus issue based on its capital reserves.
The plan had been approved by its shareholders and local securities regulators, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company has said it would omit a dividend based on its 1996 profits, but added it would issue distributable profits for 1996 along with 1997 dividend.
The company posted a net profit of 4.12 million yuan for 1996, down 60 percent from 10.23 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the firm booked net profits of 15.82 million yuan for 1996 against 20.19 million yuan for 1995.

After the bonus issue, the company's outstanding shares would rise to 163 million from the current 136 million, while its capital reserves would fall to 177 million yuan from 205 million, the statement said.
The registration deadline for the bonus issue was set at August 5, it said.
